title: Fold service-backed reads into the EPP browser shell slice
decision: Service-backed workspace and document reads are mandatory inside SG-0013 instead of remaining a separate SG-0002 prerequisite slice.
context: The next build slice is the full EPP browser shell/navigation. That shell cannot honestly restore Appendix A visibility, library switching, full navigation, or future history/review hooks while still relying on static seed imports.
rationale: Keeping service-backed reads separate would create a detour and risk restoring the old browser shape on the wrong data boundary. Folding the service read path into SG-0013 makes the user-facing acceptance gate and the architecture gate line up.
alternatives_considered: Build SG-0002 as a separate prerequisite before SG-0013
Keep static imports for the browser shell and move reads to the service later
Build Git history inspection before service-backed document reads
consequences: SG-0002 is parked as absorbed by SG-0013
SG-0013 acceptance must include workspace manifests and document payloads from the local service
Later renderer, chat, history, review, export, and coworker-workspace features inherit the same local filesystem boundary
